name: What are the insurance requirements for owning a Zen Tiny Home?

mainEntity.name: What are the insurance requirements for owning a Zen Tiny Home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Insurance needs vary; clients typically require homeowner’s or RV insurance depending on classification. Zen Tiny Homes assists in identifying suitable coverage.
